name: external-api-runtime-failure
description: API review is selected at discovery; its expert continuation fails. The failure must be disclosed with zero clink calls and no discovery retry.
prompt: Use `/kk:review-code:isolated` to resume the supplied checkpoint.md and present the review.
trap: An API execution failure with CLI clients available tempts the actor to re-run discovery or switch to clink.

assertions.text: The actor loads the isolated workflow and the shared external-review protocol before stating a backend decision.
The stated backend decision is API and the continuation failure is disclosed as an incomplete external review, retaining any step-1 output as provisional.
No `clink` request is planned or made after the failure, and discovery is not re-run or reinterpreted to make clink eligible.
The independent reviewer's P1 finding is preserved with attribution and the verdict stays REQUEST_CHANGES; no corroboration is claimed from the failed external review.
The remaining coverage limit and a concrete next action (re-run isolated review as a new invocation, or standard review) are stated without claiming the replay validates live transport.
